description: Resolve the full transitive dependency tree for a package version. Returns all direct and indirect dependencies with versions and relation type. Reveals hidden supply chain depth (e.g. express@5.2.1 has 67 transitive deps). Google deps.dev.

system.description: Package ecosystem: npm, pypi, go, maven, cargo, or nuget

version.description: Package version to resolve dependencies for (e.g. 4.17.21, 3.0.0)

name: depsdev.insights.dependencies

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Dependency Tree (deps.dev)
